children: W.P. Carey's board has nudged up the real-estate investment trust's quarterly dividend by about 1.1%, to 95 cents from 94 cents.
The new payout, equal to $3.80 a year, represents an annual yield of about 5.71% based on Thursday closing share price of $66.52.
The New York company on Friday said the increased dividend is payable Oct. 15 to shareholders of record Sept. 30.
